sleeping_bag.name: Spark Down Sleeping Bag 15F (-9C)
sleeping_bag.subtitle: current official Spark family, normalized to regular 15F/-9C
sleeping_bag.zipper_spec: full side zipper with zipper plough
sleeping_bag.key_features: Regular 15F/-9C normalized row; 730 g total; 480 g of 850+ goose down; ISO 23537 tested; full side zip; generous comfort-focused Spark cut.
sleeping_bag.marketing_summary: Sea to Summit positions the Spark as an EN/ISO-tested ultralight down bag balancing low weight with more usable space and refined comfort features than many narrow race-light designs.
sleeping_bag.manufacturer_claims: Generous cut, technical hood, RDS down with non-PFAS Ultra-Dry treatment, and laboratory-tested thermal performance.
sleeping_bag.use_cases: Backpacking and alpine trekking where low pack weight matters but true tested warmth remains a priority.
sleeping_bag.source_notes: Verified 2026-05-17. User input 'Sea To Summit Spark 15F' maps to the current official Spark Down Sleeping Bag family. Row normalized to regular 15F/-9C. Official exact USD/EUR for the 15F regular variant was not cleanly exposed in the fetched page, so numeric official prices remain null. French retailer price verified on Hardloop FR.
sleeping_bag.comparison_notes: French price preserved from a verified French retailer because the official page did not expose an exact structured price for this specific 15F regular variant in the crawl.
sleeping_bag.faq_important: Support FAQ indicates Spark construction and zipper-compatibility details by generation; this bag is not marketed as a fully open-flat quilt.
sleeping_bag.warranty_notes: Sea to Summit Guarantee for the life of the product under normal intended use.
sleeping_bag.official_price_text: Official family page showed a US family price span of US$349.00-US$999.00, but not a clean exact 15F regular price in the crawl. Verified French retailer price: 779.90 EUR on Hardloop FR.
